records.region: Northeastern Greenland, inland ice and the ice/bedrock coastal margin north of Hudson Land and west of Clavering Ø.
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: The original national cartography accounts for the entire chosen inland-ice, irregular ice/bedrock-margin and coastal-margin sequence, but neither identifies one named continuous natural river along the modeled line nor supplies a representative river identity. Nearby land, island, fjord or glacier labels cannot name the selected object.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected head lies on inland ice west of the coastal bedrock belt. The path proceeds southward, bends southwest along the ice margin, turns south and east between mapped rock bodies, continues southeast and then south across the mixed ice/rock setting, and ends after a lower eastward passage in the inner coastal-margin area north of Hudson Land. The source's contours and geological boundaries are distinguished from river traces. Hudson Land and Clavering Ø are read geographic context labels only.
records.completion_scope: All 30 selected parts and all intermediate joins are covered by the same physically retained complete original map. The chosen northern opening, upper bend, intermediate south/east connector, lower southward segment, final eastward sequence and actual endpoint were visually compared at ordinary terrain/corridor scale. No meaningful unviewed geographic interval remains. Natural-river identity, exact banks, modern glacier-front position and hydraulic continuity are outside the established scope.
records.supported_name_scope: No whole-route or representative natural-river hydronym established.

component_scope_limits: Hudson Land and Clavering Ø are geographic context labels, not river-name candidates.
No nearby glacier or fjord label is assigned to the selected feature.
The map's Inland Ice surface contours, ice-thickness isopachs and sub-ice bedrock contours are not mapped river channels.
The supplied connected model parts and sea-terminal metadata do not independently prove a natural river or river mouth.
A null candidate records that a name was not established; it does not claim that no local or official name exists.

records.region: Southern Penny Ice Cap outlet-glacier and outwash corridor, Baffin Island, Nunavut, Canada; mainland northeast of Kekertelung Island, Cumberland Sound.
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: Complete geographic coverage but no supported representative river name; a substantial upper interval is ice-cap and glacier terrain. Geographic ice correspondence does not establish a natural-river hydraulic route.
records.geographic_disambiguation: No river name is assigned. Penny Ice Cap, South/Southwest Glaciers, Kekertelung Island and Cumberland Sound are geographical context, not aliases of the selected river group.
records.completion_scope: Complete bounded geographic correspondence for the single mainstem fragment: an ice-cap opening and valley-glacier trunk descend into a continuous outwash river, meet an eastern glacier-fed stream and reach the lower alluvial corridor northeast of Kekertelung Island. The actual selected endpoint is inland of the open coastal water in the imagery. No whole-system river hydronym is supported, and the upper ice-covered selection cannot be represented as one demonstrated natural river. This is a completed name/feature-class scope hold, not an unresolved source-through-link finding.
records.supported_name_scope: No river name is assigned. Penny Ice Cap, South/Southwest Glaciers, Kekertelung Island and Cumberland Sound are geographical context, not aliases of the selected river group.

scope_limits: A river hydronym is not established; absence from the inspected sources does not prove that no Inuit, local or official name exists.
The upper geographic match is to ice-cap/glacier terrain, not evidence of a continuous natural river across that ice.

The lower detail places the selected endpoint inland on the alluvial corridor. The visible continuation reaches the coastal flats, but neither a modified endpoint nor a precise tidal limit is assigned.
Imagery scene dates, seasonal flow, exact glacier limits, bank positions and present subglacial drainage are outside this ordinary correspondence finding.
Ward–Baird Figure1 remains unobserved; its prose cannot supply the missing individual glacier-label placement.

records.material_pending_reason: One specific geographic gap: an independent ordinary-scale source establishing the selected Suruaca/coastal-channel-to-Atlantic through-link at the actual ending. General watershed identity or the separately depicted northern outlet is insufficient.
records.geographic_disambiguation: This is the Barra Seca corridor in northern Espírito Santo. The distinct Mariricu–São Mateus connection, Barra Nova outlet and named Ipiranga system explain the managed coastal setting but are not substituted for the actual selected terminal.
records.completion_scope: Rio Barra Seca is supported from the chosen western opening through the named middle/lower river and the Macuco–Suruaca lake/wetland corridor. The selected final crossing from the coastal lowland to the Atlantic is not established; one material-pending result is retained.
records.supported_name_scope: Actual river-name candidate for the supported upper/middle/lower Barra Seca corridor, including separate Macuco and Suruaca waterbody components. Full selected-feature correspondence remains pending at its actual final sea passage; no uniform name for every component is assigned.

scope_limits: Mixed-age cartography is used for bounded naming correspondence, not current hydrology or precise channel geometry.
Historical descriptions distinguish natural wetland drainage, Mariricu communication and engineered Barra Nova/Ipiranga outlets. These facts do not prove every selected terminal connector.

The study calls its local maps IBGE1:100,000-based with field checks; its own local field context is distinct from the held southern-basin article. No absent source-original or unseen map is counted as read.

records.region: Southern Córdoba, Argentina; Las Acequias–Huanchilla–Pacheco de Melo lowland corridor
records.material_pending_reason: Readable imagery covers the entire selected fragment, but agricultural/depression transfers between successive low areas and the complete approach to the irregular terminal waterbody are not established as a continuous named channel. The regional field-study and local planning prose explain modified and flood-prone drainage but do not identify this full selection. The remaining gap is material correspondence, not an exact-bank, permanent-flow or hydronym-boundary requirement.
records.geographic_disambiguation: No representative natural-river identity is established. Nearby municipal and drainage-system names are contextual leads and are not assigned to this selection.
records.completion_scope: The complete agricultural and depression landscape is visible, while meaningful inter-depression transfers, the lower loop and the incoming terminal-waterbody connection remain unresolved.
records.supported_name_scope: No representative natural-river identity is established. Nearby municipal and drainage-system names are contextual leads and are not assigned to this selection.

scope_limits: No complete independent named-channel correspondence from chosen opening to terminal.
Inter-depression and cultivated-ground transfers remain meaningful gaps, especially the south-central intervals and pronounced lower loop.
No terminal waterbody hydronym or verified receiving-channel identity.
No continuous-flow, permanent-dryness, exact-bank or modern operating-state assertion.
The available regional prose cannot extend a western basin name onto this eastern selected path.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
